reports.title: Chattahoochee And Flint River fishing report
reports.text: Water temperatures in the river are starting to come down since we have had some cool nights, so bass fishing should begin to pick up. Fly fishing on the Flint River targeting shoal bass is a lot of fun.

reports.title: Lake Seminole fishing report
reports.text: According to Ken Sturdivant at southernfishing.com, bass fishing is good. It has very sharp hooks and a sound that gets the attention of the big bass. It will get the big bass out of the grass.

reports.title: Lake Walter F. George fishing report
reports.text:
According to Ken Sturdivant at Southern Fishing, Bass fishing is fair.
Crappie are being caught on jigs in 20-25 feet of water around woody structure.
Silver Lake: Largemouth Bass continue to school near the surface during the evening hours.
Dragging a Texas-rigged worm has produced bass up to 5 pounds.

reports.title: Big Lazer Public Fishing Area fishing report
reports.text:
Region 5 Staff’s Bass catch
Largemouth Bass fishing is fair right now. When targeting bass, try shad as well as other fish-lookalike baits at a variety of depths. As the water cools, try pitching crawfish and plastic worms in deeper waters. In cooler waters, try slowing down your plastic baits to increase chances for bites. Bream fishing is generally good this time of year, and that trend should continue with the cooler water temperatures. Woody structures in shallower water all around the lake are good target areas. Live bait such as crickets and worms are extremely productive. The water is still warm enough that catfish are biting fairly well. Channel catfish are located throughout most…

reports.title: Southeast Georgia fishing report
reports.text: Nonetheless, the fishing continues to be decent in September, especially for bass and catfish in the rivers and Public Fishing Areas.

reports.title: Altamaha River fishing report
reports.text: They caught around 25 bass, and 17 of them weighed over 3 pounds. Their 5 biggest bass weighed 18 pounds. I fished the river one day this week and caught around 30 bass. I had around 20 pounds for my top 5 bass. Two anglers caught a small mess of bass on the lower river recently. Justin Harrison and his dad fished the middle river last Wednesday and landed 16 nice bass. Justin Harrison and his dad fished out of Jaycee Landing on Wednesday and caught over 30 nice bass.

reports.title: Ocmulgee Public Fishing Area fishing report
reports.text: He picked up a couple of 1 lb bass and a good one near 5 lbs.

reports.title: Dodge Public Fishing Area fishing report
reports.text: There was one other boat on the lake, and those 2 guys managed only 1 small bass. On September 16th, Michael Carter had 4 bass; 3 were in the slot limit, so he threw them back. 5 boats on the lake, and all the bass fishermen struggled to get bites.

reports.title: Hugh Gillis Public Fishing Area fishing report
reports.text: Ken Burke also caught 2 bass, both on the shaky head, a 0.75 and a 2.5 lber.

reports.title: Paradise Public Fishing Area fishing report
reports.text: Reports from the PFAs said the bass bite was pretty slow this last week of September. Area Manager Dean Barber said folks were still catching some nice mess of bluegill and catfish at Paradise PFA. Last Saturday, Paradise PFA hosted our annual OAD/Jakes Day event, which is co-sponsored by the NWTF. Over 300 kids registered for the event, and a bunch of channel catfish were caught out of the special events ponds, including seven kids landing catfish that qualified for youth angler awards.

reports.title: Lakes And Ponds fishing report
reports.text: They each caught around 40 fish (crappie, bluegill, and bass). Ten of the crappie that Tommy caught weighed around a pound. Jimmy Zinker fished at Carr Lake (near Tallahassee) last Saturday night and caught a few bass (two of them weighed 3 ½-lbs.) on a Muskie Jitterbug. Jimmy fished at a Turner County area pond on Wednesday night and landed a half dozen bass. 13-oz. monster bass this week. Matthew Bennett fished at a private lake last Saturday evening and caught around 40 bass.

reports.title: Saving Fawns and catching crappie
reports.text: This confused fawn was in the middle of the Savannah River in Clarks Hill yesterday morning swimming in circles. I used my boat to kinda steer her to the bank and after about 3 attempts she finally figured it out. Oh yeah, also caught a good mess of crappie while I was there.

reports.title: Night time bass fishing
reports.text: Who else does it I haven’t till lately. We been going down to the pond lately right at dark fish for around a hour. The big ones seems to be biting good at this time and a couple that snap the 6lb line.We get in our little rocky boat and try not to get hung on the trees limbs.It tricky unhooking in poor light.
